notes.title: Updates & Bugfixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]9/4/2025[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Version 0.1.04 is here! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements and Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more information on some tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Slight adjustments to some chest locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Some performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Campgrounds throughout Claret Woods.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a zipline from Isle Vulcan to the mainland shore.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Runes slotted into helmets and armors now bestow identical stats[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that can occur when someone opens a chest while another person is looting it, causing the chest to appear unlooted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that sometimes causes rejoining players to spectate instead of return to their character.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the player from looting chests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused enemies to randomly die.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the chest ambience to prevent it from sometimes playing on opened chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the open chest glow sometimes showing grey instead of the correct rarity color.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with shadows flickering in Argentian Coast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed more areas in the terrain that players could get stuck in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing Faunians to deal less melee damage than intended. They now correctly deal more damage with melee than other factions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As we continue to resolve bugs and boost performance, please continue to report any bugs or unexpected behaviors through the \[F8] report menu in game!

For news updates, to connect with other players, and more, please make sure to visit our community discord![/p]

notes.title: Updates & Bugfixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]8/26/2025[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Version 0.1.03 is here! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements and Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added sound effects for swimming.[/p][/*][*][p]Players may now restore their rewards, metrics, and faction progress after switching back to a prior faction.[/p][/*][*][p]Combined the Inventory and the Store tabs in the Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Global Domination on the Main Menu now automatically updates when players earn reputation.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the Capture Outpost objective to sometimes point to the Tutorial Outpost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the Survive Side-Ops completing faster than it was supposed to.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error with players losing their entry items when the match ends unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error with players sometimes teleporting after swimming on the surface of water for long durations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing players to sometimes enter a match without their teammates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing matches to end unexpectedly after one hour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing gun scopes to be black on respawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing guns to sometimes be held crooked on spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Graphical Errors with the Blitz-6 Terran SMG[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several locations on the map in which players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the the notification alert for Rewards counting Rewards that were already collected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several Player character sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Temporarily disabled the "Congested" event[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Visual Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved weight-paints on the Terran model[/p][/*][*][p]Updated several Archifact Images.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We've had a great time seeing so many different players experience Leviathan the past few days, and we can't wait to see it continue!  To talk with others, ask questions, share fun moments, and get information as soon as possible, be sure to join our discord![/p]

notes.title: Leviathan - Alpha Patch 4.0
notes.content:
Leviathan Alpha Patch 4.0

[b]Improvements & Additions[/b]
The matchmaking system has been overhauled to highly increase the odds of player interaction
We have improved deployment spawn locations based on player feedback.
The map has been reworked to streamline travel and increase the quality of player interaction.
When reaching the end of deployment, players must now extract prior to the end of the 30 minute round timer. The 3 minute high-intensity period players could extract during has been removed.
There is now a chance for any area of the map to trigger a Kaecellian invasion during tension shift. While these are extremely dangerous events, players can find very high value loot during an invasion.
A codex has been added to the escape menu, with information detailing the game's mechanics and features.
A news hub has been added to the main menu.
Audio effects have been added and improved for many features, including:
Menus
Weapons
Character Movements
Events
Interactions
Ambient Sounds

[b]Gameplay & Balance Changes[/b]
All weapons have been reworked from having multiple damage types based on range to having a more intuitive damage and range value.
All weapons have had their stats adjusted for the new metrics.
The rune system has been reworked, the amount of runes has been decreased and the power levels have been condensed. Each rune can now be applied to armor or weapons, giving different stats based on the equipment it is applied to.
AI has been adjusted, enemies should now track the player in a more realistic manner, rewarding evasive movements when fighting them.
Adjusted the sell prices and reroll costs of weapons, helmets, and armor.
Movement has been adjusted to feel less “slippery”.
Extracting from a deployment now takes 60 seconds rather than the previous 20 seconds.
Random team matchmaking has been disabled, however players can still group with steam friends prior to deploying.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
Most of the Menu and UI has been updated.
A large amount of art assets have been added or improved, including:
Underwater Caustic Visual Effects
Numerous trees and assorted foliage
Extraction Visual Effects
Explosion Visual Effects
Outpost Smoke Visual Effects
All new Rune Assets
Existing structural assets have been optimized with LOD’s and improved collision
A large amount of locations have received updates, including:
The Faundark Elder Tree
Gas Station with Charging Bays
Levendra Waterworks
The Ridge Restaurant
Cuprus Plaza Expansion - Pharmacy, Warehouse, Department Store, Midtown Grocer, Antique Store

[b]Under Construction[/b]
The map has been updated to increase the quality, as well as to improve the playing experience. This includes streamlining travel, easier navigation of landmarks, improved graphics and optimization. The map is not fully finished, and during this playtest the following buildings are still under construction:

These structures have been temporarily removed:
Angelus Sagitta [Evergreen Foothills] 
Aurelian Relocation Quarters (ARQ) [Outer Aurelia]
Terran Energy Complex (TEC) [North Commonlands] 
Shooting Range [Claret Woods]

These structures have been left as blockouts:

Castle Thedralis [Halgrande Peak]
Boating Warehouse [Lavendra Marsh]
Fishing Building [The Far Islands Structure]
Observatory [Gorgeway Cliffs]
Auronyn Tower [Gorgeway Cliffs]
City Buildings [Outer Aurelia]
Ruined buildings [Wracked Crater and Outer Aurelia]
Stone Gate Estate [Claret Woods]

These structures have been externally finished, but the interiors are currently inaccessible:
Lavendra Waterworks [Lavendra Marsh]
Pharmacy [Outer Aurelia]
Midtown Store [Outer Aurelia]
Department Store [Outer Aurelia]
Antique Store [Outer Aurelia] 
Warehouse 1 [Outer Aurelia]

Animations continue to be a work in progress. While basic movement animations are in, we are aware that some movement animations are either non-existent or do not match the action yet.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug leading to shops having infinite stock in some cases
Fixed an issue with the engine affecting the playback of many sounds
The Main Menu will now explain why you are unable to deploy
Fixed an issue where players without any items would not generate a corpse. Corpses will now last for at least 5 minutes
Fixed an issue with the in game message log not properly displaying messages
Fixed using a potion causing a gunshot sound effect to play
Fixed a bug causing map screen icons to not properly scale with map zoom.

notes.title: Leviathan Alpha Patch 4.0 Playtest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289968/4b91251d5381808bf2dd2b68ea2260f1e5f278a5.png[/img]

This playtest is a big one, as the team has put a lot of work into making massive improvements to Leviathan! We are very excited for this next playtest, and we hope you are too. The work done by the team has lead to some great changes. As usual, we don't want to completely spoil the surprise just yet, so you will have to wait until the 11th to get the full patch notes.

In the meantime, just to give you a taste of what has been improved:

Our matchmaking system has been overhauled to greatly increase the odds that players will find themselves in matches with others!

Our map has had a huge amount of work done on it, from the primary pathways around Domusalas being easier to navigate, new buildings being added, older buildings have a new look, and a whole lot more!

The team has also put a lot of work into continuing to improve balance, the sounds throughout the game, and to increase stability.

The AI has also been updated, so be prepared to face more realistic enemy troops.

We have a few pictures of the updated map to show off here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289968/d1d6c54c729a150e36e53fee9b891ef80b4874fc.jpg[/img]
The new UeaGrati Forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289968/905ea556666c9b6426c91f60fad48c05b4e9c3f2.jpg[/img]
The Lavendra Marsh has been revitalized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289968/c1f4d159d991010b127a686ed3256faf67789517.jpg[/img]
The Argentian Coast featuring the completion of some major construction.


We are very excited to share more news with you over the next two weeks, and as always we will be posting a full patchnotes just before we start the playtest, so if you miss any of the announcements you can catch yourself up then!

As always, you can access our discord [url=https://discord.gg/y6u9bDdjYa]here[/url] for more frequent communication and an easy way to connect with other Leviathan players!

We can't wait to see you all, whether we are deploying as your ally or your enemy, it is sure to be an action packed week!

notes.title: Leviathan Alpha Playtest Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[b]Leviathan Open Alpha Patch 2.0[/b]

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
More animations added to the Harrakai.
Missing glass materials have been added.
Added Santa Hats to the Domi Settler enemies to celebrate the Holiday season.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
AI will no longer get stuck in outposts and stay stationary forever.
Fixed beast death animations.
Fixed a bug with insufficient funds on the reforge screen showing as if the user had enough Domirium.
Fixed purchase requests for multiple stacks of an item in the store giving less of the item than intended.
Several visual UI Fixes, including fixes related to scrollbar tuning.
Fixed a bug that would not allow the player to extract when they had completed an Extract or Collection Quest.
Fixed a bug with Reward items not immediately showing up in the stash when collected.

The patch will be applied and servers will be available starting at 7:00 PM EST on 12/27, until Midnight EST on Sunday, 12/29.
